title: AgentDoc Validation Runtime Receipt
description: Digest-bound receipt returned by the pinned AgentDoc Validation Runtime (SEMANTICS S6, MILESTONES E1.7). Deterministic by contract: stable ordering, no wall-clock timestamps anywhere — evaluation_date is the explicit lifecycle-pinning input, never 'today'. This JSON Schema is preflight and documentation only, never domain authority (ADR-0015): a payload this schema accepts may still be domain-invalid, and only the runtime's typed validation constructs the receipt. runtime.binary_digest is supplied by the invoking harness as an explicit attested input (a binary cannot hash itself deterministically); the harness verifies the binary's sha256 against its recorded pin before invoking (scripts/validation-runtime/run.sh).

runtime.description: Exact runtime identity: the release version of the invoking adoc surface and the harness-attested sha256 of its binary.

contract_versions.description: Consumed contract versions, keyed by contract role. 'graph' names the graph contract this runtime's semantics validate (adoc.graph.v6); a consumed context artifact must match it exactly or the run fails with schema.unsupported_version.

evaluation_date.description: The explicit lifecycle evaluation date input (adoc check --as-of). Mandatory in receipt mode so the receipt never depends on the wall clock.

inputs.description: Every consumed source input: Logical Source Path plus sha256 of its bytes, in lexicographic path order.

context.description: Named validation-context inputs where applicable: 'config' (the discovered project config file) and 'context_artifact' (a graph artifact validated against the recompiled source).

result.description: Closed result vocabulary. fail is recorded, never suppressed: a domain-invalid input yields a receipt with result fail and typed diagnostics behind diagnostics_digest.

diagnostics_digest.description: sha256 over the canonically serialized (compact JSON) typed diagnostics array of the run, in the runtime's stable source order.
